question: What is the system of government in which one person holds absolute and unrestricted power is called?
solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 1) Autocracy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Autocracy** refers to a system of government in which one person holds absolute and unrestricted power. (स्वेच्छाचारिता, निरंकुश शासन)

 
 
• **Example:** The nation was ruled for decades by an autocracy that suppressed any form of dissent.
 
 
 
• In an autocracy, the power resides in the hands of a single individual, often without the need for consent or checks and balances from other branches of government.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Autocracy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their meanings:

 
• **Autonomy** (स्वायत्तता): The right or condition of self-government, particularly in a specified territory or institution.

 
 
• **Example:** The region was granted autonomy after decades of political struggle.
 
 
 
• **Bureaucracy** (नौकरशाही): A system of government in which most of the decisions are made by state officials rather than by elected representatives.
 
 
• **Example:** The cumbersome bureaucracy often caused delays in delivering public services.
 
 
 
• **Democracy** (लोकतंत्र): A system of government by the whole population or all the eligible members of a state, typically through elected representatives.
 
 
• **Example:** The country prospered under a stable and inclusive democracy.
